svg.aria-label: Each square is one of the 512 tasks of the original training set, stacked by how often a 9B model solves the task in eight attempts. Red squares are tasks whose hidden tests reject correct fixes: 57 of the 77 never-solved tasks (74%), then 41%, 36%, 16%, 26%, 14%, 8% and 11% of the tasks solved one to seven times.
svg.text: the hidden tests reject correct fixes
solved in 1 to 7 of eight attempts
